summary: CareTrust REIT, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 18, 2026, announcing a common stock offering of 12,500,000 firm shares (plus up to 1,875,000 optional shares) at $40.225 per share to underwriters. The offering closed on May 20, 2026. Concurrently, the Company entered forward sale agreements with Wells Fargo and JPMorgan for the firm shares, under which forward sellers borrowed and sold shares, with physical settlement expected by May 20, 2027. The Company may elect cash or net share settlement. This structured equity capital raise, via forward sales, defers dilution and provides proceeds; watch for eventual settlement method and share price impact.
